text:
Sara: Hey team — quick help needed for ACME POC. Procurement asked whether we can accept a PO for the POC invoice (they want net30) instead of applying self-serve credits. They also want 'pricing floor / ceiling' language on the order form and a delegated signer. Any immediate blockers from Legal / Sec? :thinking:

Maria: @Sara I can take the DPA/redline view. Delegated signer is OK in principle but we need an explicit delegation clause and a named delegated signer (email + title) recorded in the order form or an attachment. Also we should translate any SLA penalty to a capped credit dollar amount for the POC (avoid open-ended liability).

Devon: Security note: POC on PO is fine provided there is a written data handling boundary — explicitly no production data and no external dataset uploads. Also need subprocessors list updated if they want data access beyond logs. Send redlines our way.

James: From eng: we can support the POC traffic, but strongly advise against hard SLA monetary penalties for a POC. Recommend credit-based remedies and a per-month cap. If they insist on a ceiling we can offer an "effective ceiling" by limiting model config (shorter seq, reduced kv cache) to bound token costs.

Priya: PS/Billing ops: We can accept a PO — finance requires a PO number on the invoice and an invoice contact. Delegated signer is OK if procurement provides a signed delegation statement or a PO with signature block. For pricing floor/ceiling we typically do one of two options: 1) Minimum monthly commitment (floor), or 2) Per-unit price ceiling (e.g., unit price will not exceed $X during the POC). Need to know which ACME prefers.

Sara: Thanks. Maria — can you draft suggested order-form language that converts SLA uptime into a dollar credit cap? I want something we can hand to procurement.

Maria: Draft below — please review. This is intentionally conservative for POC:  

```
SLA Credits (POC). For the POC period, Redwood Inference will target an availability SLA of 99.0%. If monthly availability falls below the SLA, Customer may request a service credit equal to the lesser of (a) 25% of that month's Fees for the POC, or (b) $10,000. The maximum aggregate credit available to Customer for any single month during the POC shall not exceed the Fees paid by Customer for that month. For the avoidance of doubt, for POC engagements the parties agree the maximum aggregate liability for SLA credits will not exceed the Fees paid for the POC period.
```

Maria: And a short delegation snippet to include on the order form: 

```
Delegation of Signature. Customer represents and warrants that the individual executing this Order Form on Customer's behalf is authorized to do so and that Customer's procurement officer, [NAME] ([EMAIL]), is authorized to sign Orders and POs on behalf of the applicable Customer entity for the POC period. Redwood may rely on any PO or signed Order referencing this Order Form as binding.
```

Devon: Add a short security addendum line in the order form: "POC data scope limited to non-production test data; no external dataset uploads unless expressly authorized; subprocessors list as of execution attached as Appendix A."

BillingBot: Invoice created — invoice #PO-4098 for ACME POC (amount $12,000). View: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/PO-4098 :moneybag:

Sara: Looping in procurement@acme.com — can you confirm the PO number and delegated signer? @James can you confirm you can map the SLO -> variant (reduced seq/kv) for this POC by EOD tomorrow?

James: Yep, I'll push a canary route tagged `acme-poc` with reduced KV cache and a 512 token default by EOD. Will post the config snippet once deployed.

Priya: Finance note — net30 preferred, but net45 can be accommodated if requested. Also need billing contact and billing code on the PO (please supply).

Maria: I'll prepare a redline of the order form with the SLA credit clause, delegation snippet, and security addendum, then share a Drive link.

Devon: I'll review subprocessors and attest whether any additional controls are needed.

Sara: Great — action items: @Maria redline order form, @Devon subproc review, @James route/config, @Priya confirm billing details. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup:

Maria: I'll upload v1 in ~60m (link will be posted here).
